action.objective: Verify f2xg3, the reserved suggestion, at full depth to secure queen safety and win the g3 rook.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search favors f2g3 (exact 2006), but f2xg3 directly captures the black rook on g3 with the f2 pawn; need full verification since d1 queen and e1 king are exposed. Reserved verification allows 2000 nodes at max depth 4.
